execution.description: The runner executes each prompt with an authenticated Codex CLI and evaluates deterministic output assertions.

cases.prompt: 把设置页按钮文案从“保存”改成“保存更改”，不要改动其他行为。

must: Perform only the requested copy change.
must_not: Ask the user to choose a data structure or algorithm.

cases.prompt: 给现有的内存用户列表补一个按唯一 ID 删除用户的方法；数据量很小，没有新的性能或持久化要求。

must: Use the existing representation unless repository evidence requires a change.
Keep any incidental complexity note brief when it is useful.
must_not: Pause only to ask the user to select an internal implementation detail.

cases.prompt: 设计一个接口，从持续增长的千万级事件流中返回最近一小时得分最高的 100 条记录。写入远多于读取，内存有明确上限；先给方案，不要替我做重大取舍。

must: State workload assumptions and resource bounds.
Compare two or three viable Top-K designs with time, memory, I/O, and maintenance tradeoffs.
Recommend one design and identify when another becomes better.
Wait before implementation because the user retained the material decision.
must_not: Implement before the user selects a materially different design.
Recommend an unbounded structure without addressing the memory limit.

required_regex: (?:近似|Space-Saving|Count-Min|外部|持久化|数据库|磁盘)

cases.prompt: 为千万级事件流设计最近一小时按得分返回 Top-100 记录的查询。请你依据这些约束选择最合适的方案；内部数据结构和算法由你决定。先给最终设计与验证计划，不写代码，也不要让我二次选择。

must: Make the delegated choice from the supplied constraints.
Briefly record the selected design, rationale, and key complexity.
Provide a concrete validation plan without asking the user to select among internal designs.
must_not: Pause merely to ask the user to choose among viable internal designs.
